We absolutely love this doggy daycare! 🐾❤️ Mocha always has a blast and comes home happy and tired. Most importantly, I know she is well taken care of while she’s there, which gives me so much peace of mind.
I feel completely comfortable leaving her with the team because she is ALWAYS excited when we pull up—she can’t wait to get inside! 🥰 The trainers are amazing, knowledgeable, and truly great with the dogs. You can tell they genuinely care about the dogs they work with.
We’ve had the best experience overall and couldn’t be happier with the care Mocha receives. Highly recommend!

My dog was there for four weeks of boarded training and I purchased the lifetime maintenance package as well but never returned. If they can't train a dog for common behavioral issues at a young age (1 year) in four weeks time on-site then what's the point of going back? I wasted all that money entirely. Caveat emptor, big time.

i had my dog trained quite some time ago, (a few years ago even) and it completely slipped my mind that i can leave a review. Firstly i want to say, that the staff were nice and Corrigall, they had a good front store manner, however i cannot suggest the business for one simple reason.

I took my Chocolate Labrador here, and we specifically told the staff that we didn't want choke collars or shock collars, and that was understood. When we completed the training, it was to our surprise that we found out that they used a Metal 'Pinch collar' on her to get her to obey their commands. she wasn't trained, she was turned into a circus animal.  (By which she immediately backslid because you don't train a dog with force.)

I have since trained her myself and she is obedient and compliant without use of cruel and forceful means.

Things may have changed, and for the sake of humane animal treatment i hope it did.

I'm well aware that they train aggressive dogs here, but our case was different.

Our dog was a Chocolate Labrador retriever with PIKA (a anxiety disorder where she compulsively chews on things such as socks etc. this is fixed by dog toy association, and verbal correction), as well as jumping, and leash pulling.

Conclusion;

We took a 1 and a half year old chocolate lab with separation anxiety to be trained, with specific requests and instead indirectly subjected our dog to a trainer who uses metallic pinch collars to force obedience and compliance instead of boundaries and correction training.
Looked little thin when we got him back.

My precious 14-year-old rescue dog, Codi, is having difficulty standing during an entire bath due to arthritis and a torn ACL on her right leg.  She's ~65 pounds, has LOTS of hair and had never been to a groomer/bather (we've always bathed her ourselves).  I was trying to find a groomer who had a lift that could help keep her upright during a bath but couldn't find one.  I contacted 5-7 places in central Houston and Brenda at Man's Best Friend won me over (even though they don't have a lift).  When I told her our predicament and my concerns, she immediately put me at ease by explaining her (and Man's Best Friend's) love of and care for older dogs saying they've handled many of their customer's animals for their whole lives.  She gave me the confidence that they would love Codi and handle her with care - allowing her to sit/rest, when she needed to.  Even though it was a 30-minute drive away and I had to find a place to get her a Bordetella vaccine prior to the grooming, I thought it would be worth it and I was right!
I called to confirm prior to our visit and spoke with Amarissa who was also very kind and helpful.  When we arrived, I was introduced to Craig, the groomer, who was also very kind and gentle with Codi.  I agreed to have him remove her undercoat (which we will definitely do again) along with the bath, ear cleaning and nail clipping.  I felt guilty about leaving her there alone, but she was clean and happy when I picked her up and the decrease in her shedding has been amazing!
The team at Man's Best Friend on Bingle is a hard act to follow!  Knowing that I'm leaving Codi in good hands is the only way I'd transfer this responsibility at her old age.

Board & Train at Man’s Best Friend – A Disappointing and Costly Mistake

I enrolled my two dogs in the board and train program at Man’s Best Friend with high hopes, but unfortunately, the experience has been deeply disappointing. For a premium price of nearly $2,000 per dog for a two week *board training* program, I expected clear communication, noticeable command improvements, and professionalism. What I received was the exact opposite. The dogs were urinating mid-eating, while being monitored and supervised. This had never happened before. Not to mention, they did not recognize any of the commands I was promised they would be trained on. Not too mention, we had a vet visit scheduled one week into their training and when we picked them up, they had a strong stench of pee, which was, "poetically" bypassed when raising this concern, however trusting their program, we cleaned them up and brought them back after their vet visit - just to find out that the obedience and training board training we were promised, agreed too and paid for, was not the case at all.

When I asked about to demonstrate the, "stay" command upon picking them up, Mandy responded she doesn't teach that, when it was clearly written in their paperwork and promised. Upon reaching out to the staff, responses relative to these concerns—especially after it became apparent that the training results were not aligning with what was promised. Instead of a resolution, I received scripted replies and a deflection of responsibility. While being offered a free bath, as well as, an option to bring them back 24 hours after spending two weeks for a, "board training" program. Which made absolute no sense. Especially for the amount of money they charged for a two week board training program - which became apparent that was more so boarding - not a board training program. There was no transparency in the process, no accountability, and no ownership when I voiced my dissatisfaction.

As a customer who trusted this facility with my pets, I regret my decision and would not recommend their training services to anyone. My dogs came back 10x worse and the service I had was relative to their, "Board Training" program. If you’re looking for genuine results and care for your pet(s), I strongly encourage exploring other options.

Ms. Tellez, thank you for the 5-stars. Man's Best Friend Houston appreciates you taking the time to let us know how we are doing. We are here for you and your pet whenever your need arrives whether it is Grooming, Boarding, Training or Daycare.

If you're looking for a place that treats your dog like family, Man's Best Friend is the place to go! I don't trust my dog with just anyone. The staff takes top notch quality care of Luka and I won't be going anywhere else. Here's a breakdown of everything, and I hope you take the time to read it.

Trainers- Mandy has been excellent with training Luka. Not only does she have a load of experience training dogs she also teaches you how to speak their language in a way that is easy to understand. I have been to several trainers throughout my lifetime and I think she does the best with providing well balanced training. I have been seeing her for almost a year and Luka has changed leaps and bounds. With that being said, though, as owners, we have to take accountability of consistently training our dogs when we leave the facility. Too many people want to blame their dog's regression on the trainer, when it's actually the owner's lack of consistency.

Groomer- Luka is a highly reactive dog. He does not like most people touching him. Craig was able to handle Luka with kindness and understanding. This resulted in a very pleasant experience for Luka, and he came out of the grooming session happy. Luka will be groomed by him for now on.

Staff- They are kind, pleasant, and compassionate. I can tell they really like their jobs and care about the animals that come to their facility.

Boarding/Facility- One of the things I like is that they are small. Due to this, they are able to pay every animal in their care the attention they deserve. I have been to other facilities that are much larger and treat me like I'm just a number or a way to make money. Man's Best Friend takes care of my dog like I would. They also have a fenced in yard they take the dogs out to play in. So I'm not worried about Luka, not getting enough exercise or care.

Please take your dog here. You're doing them a disservice, if you don't!

Cannot say enough good about this place! Mandy and Brenda are fantastic. Mandy is literally a godsend at helping pet owners work towards their training goals. She not only knows how to address the tasks in a way the dogs understand; she also knows how to teach in a way that the humans on the leash can understand and lead their pets successfully.
This company should be greatful to have Mandy on their team because she is definitely an asset to them and their clientele.

This place is AWFUL!! My poor pup came home traumatized. Do not take your pets here… I live only a couple miles away and thought it would be wonderful to have a groomer and daycare so close by. I immediately felt like something was off when they tried to whisk my dog away for grooming even though we discussed only doing her first day of daycare that day. But, she desperately needed a grooms so I convinced myself I was over reacting. After she went back with the groomer, I asked to see the play area. The room was no bigger than 15’x12’. And the TWO dogs were in cages, not supervised or playing. I was told they were “resting”. At 8am?? No.

I picked my dog up and was told “she did well. She was timid but interested”… ok? She plays perfectly fine with other dogs at the dog park, in our neighborhood, and at Tiffany Kennels day care. Sounds like a facility issue to me.

She wanted NOTHING to do with the groomer as soon as I arrived. I have no idea what could have happened, but it was the most anxious I’ve seen my dog in two years. Even today at her vet, who she loves, she was an anxious mess. Her trip to MBF has left lasting damage. Do NOT take your dog here. It’s not a good place for them.
Horrible job. Buyer beware
